name: Le Fleuriste Provençal
description: Bringing the beauty of Provence to your everyday life.
story: Le Fleuriste Provençal is a family-owned business that has been cultivating flowers in Provence for three generations. Inspired by the speed and precision of motorsport, they see a parallel to the delicate art of flower cultivation. They hope to connect with a wider audience who appreciate the finer things in life, and associate their brand with success and French elegance.
